text:
Dubai recorded 10,195 residential sales worth AED 27.67bn over the last four weeks, a 6.1% decline in volume compared to the previous period. Mortgage registrations stood at 4,054, which are tracked separately from sales transactions. The market saw a shift in product mix as the off-plan share decreased to 59.4% from 66.6% in the prior four weeks. This activity level reflects a modest contraction in transaction counts while maintaining significant total value.

Median residential pricing settled at AED 1,666 per square foot, representing a 1.8% decrease from the previous four-week median of AED 1,697. The reduction in off-plan transactions coincided with this slight price adjustment. Top performing areas by sales volume included Dubai South with 3,783 units and Jumeirah Village Circle with 2,313 units over the last twelve weeks. Pricing in Dubai South remained stable at AED 1,693 per square foot, while Jumeirah Village Circle saw a 2.6% decline to AED 1,407 per square foot.

The rental market registered 92,517 Ejari contracts, with 50.2% classified as renewals. The median residential rent stood at AED 70,000 annually. Yield opportunities remain concentrated in specific communities, with Zaabeel First offering the highest estimated gross yield at 9.1% for flats. International City Phase 1 followed at 8.6%, and Town Square recorded 7.0%. These figures are based on median rent and price data for the respective property types within the benchmark filters.

Investors should monitor Al Yufrah 1, which showed a 37.7% increase in median price per square foot over twelve weeks. Conversely, Liwan experienced a 14.0% price drop, and Palm Deira fell by 13.3%. The anomaly monitor flagged 1,076 sales in the last 60 days that deviated significantly from comparable medians. These figures are derived from registered DLD data and Ejari contracts, using medians and benchmark filters that exclude bulk deals, partial shares, and statistical outliers.

facts.ranking_rule: communities with at least 30 eligible sales in both 12-week windows; yields also need 30 rent contracts of the same property type
